meta.purpose: Canonical machine-owned queue for Truck_Opti launch normalization.
notes: Keep at most two active tasks.
Use proof-driven validation on every task.
Treat live credential blockers explicitly instead of hiding them inside generic launch work.

tasks.title: Add the sellable product contract artifact
tasks.why: TruckOpti is being carried as a sellable near-launch product, but the repo still lacks an accepted contract artifact that ties the live launch slice to one owned surface.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Truck_Opti has an accepted product contract artifact and the launch, task, and handoff surfaces all point at the same sellable-product slice.
validation: Run 0.dev-matrix/sync-two-task-loop.ps1 -Mode manual and confirm the active pair points at the live sellable-product slice.
tasks.businessValue: Turns TruckOpti's launch claims into contract-backed commercial readiness instead of implied product scope.

tasks.title: Prepare the post-credentials launch proof surface
tasks.why: The remaining hard blocker is live Razorpay credentials, so the repo needs an explicit proof path that can be run immediately once those credentials exist.
tasks.definitionOfDone: TruckOpti names the exact post-credential validation sequence for launch readiness, live auth proof, and production configuration proof.
tasks.businessValue: Removes ambiguity between a configuration blocker and the proof steps needed to convert TruckOpti into a live sellable product.

tasks.title: Provision live Razorpay credentials for launch
tasks.why: TruckOpti's current blocker is not another code refactor. It is the absence of live Razorpay production credentials in the target environment.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Production Razorpay credentials are present in the live environment and the repo can proceed to launch proof without pretending the blocker is solved in code.
tasks.businessValue: Unblocks the only hard production launch blocker currently recorded for TruckOpti.

tasks.title: Verify controlled live checkout proof
tasks.why: Live Razorpay keys, GST-disabled billing, and the production checkout bundle are already deployed. The remaining payment-side launch proof is one controlled authenticated checkout that reaches the server-side verify-razorpay-payment path on the live site.
tasks.definitionOfDone: One controlled authenticated live checkout on https://www.truckopti.in reaches the server-side verify-razorpay-payment path with GST disabled and the outcome is captured in the launch surfaces.
validation: Run one controlled authenticated checkout on https://www.truckopti.in and confirm the verify-razorpay-payment path completes.
tasks.businessValue: Turns production payment readiness from config-only confidence into revenue-grade proof.

tasks.title: Retest returning-user stale-client recovery
tasks.why: The old stale checkout/UI problem was traced to a cached service worker on the public host and mitigated with sw-v2.js plus corrected origin cache headers. Launch proof still needs one returning-user/browser-cache retest against the new service-worker path.
tasks.definitionOfDone: A returning-user retest confirms the live app updates onto the sw-v2.js path without stale chunk failures or old checkout payment-logo regressions, and the proof is captured in the launch surfaces.
validation: Open a returning-user/browser-cache path on https://www.truckopti.in and confirm the live checkout renders the new payment badges with no stale chunk failures.
tasks.businessValue: Reduces launch risk for returning users by proving stale-client recovery on the live host rather than only in code or origin headers.

tasks.title: Capture normalized TruckOpti launch evidence
tasks.why: The repo should finish the launch slice with explicit proof and aligned handoff surfaces once the live checkout proof and stale-client retest are captured.
tasks.definitionOfDone: TruckOpti handoff, state, task board, and closeout all reflect the same validated live payment and stale-client launch evidence.
validation: Run 0.dev-matrix/sync-two-task-loop.ps1 -Mode manual after the proof files are updated.
tasks.businessValue: Locks launch readiness into durable proof that sales and delivery work can trust.

tasks.title: Restore five production SPA routes on truckopti.in
tasks.why: Webwright full-app smoke 2026-06-01 caught five public routes (/login, /signup, /forgot-password, /terms, /privacy) returning 404 on the live host, even though all five are declared in frontend/src/App.tsx and the Heroku server.js SPA fallback is in place. The most likely cause is Heroku frontend/dist drift from a snapshot SHA rather than from a normal reviewed commit, and the npm test regression lane does not cover React routes so the regression slipped past CI.
tasks.definitionOfDone: All five public routes resolve on https://www.truckopti.in to their owned React pages (no 404 title, no Page not found H1), the Webwright full-app smoke step 04-08 evidence is updated, and the result is captured in STATE.md, AI-HANDOFF.md, and LAST-REVIEW.md.
tasks.businessValue: Restores the live user-journey entry points for login, signup, password recovery, and legal pages so the launch slice matches the public marketing surface.

tasks.title: Reconcile deployed login surface with the launch checklist
tasks.why: Webwright 2026-06-01 step 10 and step 12 show that the only actionable button on the deployed /login page routes through Supabase-hosted Google OAuth. The email+6-digit OTP UI documented in OTPPage.tsx, otp_service.py, and supabase/config.toml is not reachable on the live host, which contradicts LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md row 2.1 (Email live; phone deferred) and the 2026-05-13 Copilot-073 launch audit. The cause is either VITE_AUTH_EMAIL_OTP_ENABLED=false in Heroku build env, or a deployed bundle that predates the email OTP code; pick one and reconcile the launch surfaces.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Either the email+6-digit OTP UI is reachable on the deployed /login page and a real email-OTP sign-in completes, or the launch checklist, OTPPage.tsx, and docs are explicitly retired as dead code and the public marketing surface is updated to advertise Google-only sign-in. The chosen path is recorded in STATE.md and AI-HANDOFF.md.
validation: Read heroku config --app truck-opti-app-efabf95bd306 | grep VITE_AUTH_EMAIL_OTP_ENABLED
tasks.businessValue: Aligns the public launch checklist with the actual deployed login surface and removes a documented user-journey contradiction.

tasks.title: Apply and exercise the 4-digit job_offer OTP migration
tasks.why: The new 4-digit OTP migration is committed in c01d3fc1 and covered by frontend/src/services/jobOfferOtpContract.test.ts (6 vitest cases), but the 2026-06-01 AI-HANDOFF explicitly states it has not been applied to any Supabase project. Until it is applied and exercised against a real public.job_offers row, the trigger and CHECK constraints are file-only and the contract is not actually enforced in production.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Migration 20260601223849 is applied to a non-prod Supabase project, a public.job_offers row with NULL pickup_otp and delivery_otp is inserted and shows 4-digit OTP values after the trigger fires, and an INSERT of malformed (non-^[0-9]{4}$) OTPs is rejected by the CHECK constraints. The applied migration record and the proof artefacts are captured in STATE.md and AI-HANDOFF.md.
tasks.businessValue: Promotes the 4-digit driver pickup/delivery OTP contract from a test-only assertion to a database-enforced invariant.

tasks.title: Validate uncommitted apps/web Python changes
tasks.why: git status --short against c01d3fc1 shows five modified apps/web files that are uncommitted and unvalidated: cost_engine.py (+8/-8), packer.py (+33/-33), routes.py (+1/-1), tests/test_drill_down_api.py (+5/-3), and tests/test_enhanced_features.py (+91/-121). The most recent apps/web pytest lane ran on 2026-05-01 against a different tree, and the 2026-05-29 launch-check was already 2/17 FAIL on a different dirty tree. Carrying unvalidated apps/web changes forward into the launch slice breaks the clean-tree launch proof.
tasks.definitionOfDone: Either the five uncommitted apps/web files are committed after a focused pytest rerun that shows the change is safe, or they are explicitly reverted/parked so the working tree can be clean. The result is captured in STATE.md and AI-HANDOFF.md.
tasks.businessValue: Restores clean-tree launch proof and prevents unvalidated Python drift from compounding into the next launch slice.
